integrity: The proof is an exact constrained minimization. Both budget constraints are shown to saturate, the remaining one-variable maximum is split at its unique crossing, both branches are differentiated explicitly, and the product minimizer is obtained from an exact cubic factorization. Numerical substitutions are used only as stress tests.
scientific_limitations: The result optimizes the explicit theorem-proof guarantees C_+ and C_- from the focal paper. It does not claim those bounds are exact operator norms, nor that the frontier is optimal over all positive isomorphisms satisfying the retract hypotheses.
title: Exact forward/inverse guarantee frontier in the positive Cantor–Bernstein construction
